featuredProjects.title: Built evidence, not promises.

process.title: From first coordination to handover.
process.lead: A clear technical structure keeps each programme moving through planning, engineering control, site execution and final delivery.

steps.title: Pre-construction coordination
steps.body: Scope, programme requirements, quantities and site constraints are aligned before work commences on site.

steps.title: Engineering & All-Trades Control
steps.body: Engineers, architects and technical managers coordinate secondary trades, structures, MEP, roads and networks.

steps.title: Site execution
steps.body: Construction managers and site teams organise daily progress, trade sequencing and material movement.

steps.title: Quality, safety & schedule monitoring
steps.body: Delivery is tracked against technical requirements, safety regulations, finish quality and contractual milestones.

steps.title: Handover & aftercare
steps.body: Final works are concluded to achieve practical completion, supported by full documentation and a focus on the long-term use of each asset.

about.title: Technical expertise. Controlled delivery.
about.credential: Professional Qualification and Classification Certificate, Category 6
paragraphs: Founded in 2018 and managed by civil engineer Adem Talay, SARL Igloo Yapi Construction works from Bir Khadem, Algiers, on residential and mixed-use programmes across Algeria.
The company holds a Professional Qualification and Classification Certificate, Category 6, and operates with a qualified building manager, engineers, architects, construction managers and site staff.

proofs.title: Category 6 Contractor
proofs.body: Professional Qualification and Classification Certificate, Category 6.

proofs.title: Multidisciplinary Team
proofs.body: Building manager, three engineers, two architects, construction managers, HR, accountant, buyer and site teams.

proofs.title: Residential & Mixed-use Expertise
proofs.body: Housing, villas, commercial premises, roads, networks, services and external works.

footprint.title: Project Footprint Across Algeria
footprint.lead: Eleven project locations across four highlighted wilayas, with a dense Algiers delivery belt and active reach toward Mostaganem and Boumerdes.
